cmd: pwd; git status -sb; ls -a; ls src; find src/framework -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort; command -v docmgr; node -v; ls -a | grep docmgr; find . -not -path './ttmp/*' -not -path './node_modules/*' -name AGENTS.md -print
docmgr status --summary-only; docmgr vocab list --category topics; docmgr milestone --help | head -25; ls src/typed; ls tests/typed; ls tests/framework; git rev-parse --short HEAD

rg -n 'defineIR|createArtifact|validateArtifact|defineTransformation|function defineInvariant' src/framework/contracts/definitions.ts; rg -n 'blocksAdapter|BlocksIR|rebuild|relationKinds' src/typed/ir.ts; rg -n 'constructor|rebuild|current|head' src/framework/ir/transactions.ts; rg -n 'runDifferential|definePass\(|applyPassSync' src/framework tests/framework; ls -d dist node_modules || true; rg -n 'typescript|build' package.json; docmgr ticket create-ticket --ticket IRWB-020-J --title 'Tix stage 1: language, tensor IR, evaluators, meaning contract and checked passes' --topics compiler,ir,verification

docmgr doc add --ticket IRWB-020-J --doc-type design-doc --title 'Design: Tix programs and checked tensor passes'; docmgr doc add --ticket IRWB-020-J --doc-type reference --title 'Implementation diary'; find ttmp -path '*/IRWB-020-J--*' -type f | sort; command -v tsc; rg -n 'export function meaningKept' src/typed/evaluate.ts; rg -n 'runDifferential|optimizationContract|applyPass\(' tests/typed/{passes,evaluate-analyses,meaning-memo,strategies,mutate}.test.mjs

node --input-type=module - <<'JS' const a=Float32Array.of(1,0,0,0,2**-24,2**-24,2**-24); const sum=x=>x.reduce((s,v)=>Math.fround(s+v),0), bits=v=>new Uint32Array(Float32Array.of(v).buffer)[0].toString(16); const s=sum(a), t=sum([sum(a.slice(0,4)),sum(a.slice(4))]), r=a.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0); console.log(s,bits(s),t,bits(t),r,Math.abs(t-r)); console.log('signed zero bits',bits(-0),'rational probe',3n*2n===6n); JS rg -n 'BigInt\(|\b[0-9]+n\b' src/framework src/typed | head -8; git status --porcelain

rg -n 'validatePorts|validatePort|assertPorts|checkPorts' src/framework/contracts; docmgr task add --help | head -45; docmgr changelog update --help | head -40; git log -1 --oneline; find ttmp -path '*/IRWB-020-J--*' -type f | wc -l

set -eu; t=IRWB-020-J; d=$(find ttmp -type d -name "$t--*"); design=$(find "$d/design-doc" -name '*.md'); diary=$(find "$d/reference" -name '*.md'); docmgr doc relate --doc "$design" --file-note "$PWD/src/framework/passes/define-pass.ts:Async pass application, write checking and contract boundary to compare against" --file-note "$PWD/src/framework/contracts/differential.ts:Existing side-aware synchronous checker and evidence" --file-note "$PWD/src/framework/ir/transactions.ts:Draft preparation without publishing a revision" --file-note "$PWD/src/typed/project.ts:Origin-anchored acceptance precedent"; docmgr doc relate --doc "$diary" --file-note "$PWD/src/framework/core/data.ts:Canonical finite JSON representation that motivates preserving literal text and external runtime buffers"; docmgr task add --ticket "$t" --text 'Write stage-1 design, framework delta ledger and first diary checkpoint.'; docmgr task check --ticket "$t" --id 1; for x in 'Review the design before implementation and record resulting decisions.' 'Implement Tix parsing, static checks and validated index IR artifact.' 'Implement f32 and f64 evaluators and row-major API tests.' 'Implement the reviewed framework change and compare against existing pass application.' 'Implement sampled contracts, inline and split-sum; exercise exact, tolerance and mutant rejections.' 'Add all six tensor corpus programs, run tensor/framework/affected Typed suites, finalize the framework delta ledger and diary.'; do docmgr task add --ticket "$t" --text "$x"; done; docmgr changelog update --ticket "$t" --entry 'Submitted stage-1 design for review, including the proposed synchronous pass gate and a numerical split-sum witness; no compiler changes.' --file-note "$PWD/$design:Design and framework delta ledger"; docmgr doctor --ticket "$t" --stale-after 30; git status --porcelain

set -eu; d=$(find ttmp -type d -name 'IRWB-020-J--*'); git status --porcelain; git diff --stat; git diff --cached --stat; git add -- "$d"; git diff --cached --stat; git diff --cached --name-only; git diff --cached --check; docmgr doctor --ticket IRWB-020-J --stale-after 30; git commit -m 'IRWB-020-J: Design Tix IR, evaluators and checked tensor passes'; git rev-parse HEAD; git status -sb
